summary: The EmailPopupDocument system manages email files and their directories. It provides functionalities to search and delete email documents based on the folder and file path.
purpose: To manage the storage and deletion of email-related documents, ensuring files and their containing directories are properly handled.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: Path where the email file is stored.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Indicates if an EmailPopupDocument has been checked.

workflows.name: Search Email Documents
steps: Split DataInfo into individual emailData segments using '|' as delimiter.
For each emailData: split it further using '>' to extract FileName and FilePath.
Create EmailPopupDocument objects for each valid emailData and add them to the list.

workflows.name: Delete Email Document
steps: Input DataInfo string and ID to be deleted.
Identify the emailData segment corresponding to the provided ID.
Extract folderName from FilePath, attempt to delete the file and folder.

validations: Check if DataInfo is not null or empty before processing.
conditions: If emailData length is 2, proceed with processing; otherwise, ignore.
system_behavior: Deletes specific email files and their directories when requested.
Handles and skips non-existent files or directories during deletion.
exceptions: Try-catch blocks are used to handle exceptions during file and directory deletion without breaking the process.
